description: This file contains test cases for audit-seams, classifying different code snippets as belonging to specific seams within the project. It uses Vitest for testing and imports functions from audit-seams.mjs. The tests examine seam detection in various files related to cron jobs, subagents, and orchestrations, as well as checking documentation and status functions.

methods.name: runCronIsolatedAgentTurn
methods.description: Simulates a cron agent turn, registering context, running CLI agent, delivering payloads, and building session context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Cron service startup function that loads, recomputes, persists state, arms timer, runs missed jobs, and computes next run time.

methods.name: spawnSubagentDirect
methods.description: Handles spawning a subagent, registering its lifecycle, calling gateway functions, and emitting lifecycle events.

methods.name: completeRun
methods.description: Completes a subagent run, resolving context, capturing completion reply, emitting end hook, persisting state, and announcing flow.

methods.name: startAcpSpawnParentStreamRelay
methods.description: Starts a parent stream relay for ACP spawn, listening to agent events, requesting heartbeat, enqueuing system event, and returning relay info.
